theorem: Cycle 2-CNF has canonical source-incidence 2-core width k=n and encoding size L=4n. For every fixed real c>0, take C=ceil(max(1,c)) and n=16*C^2. Then 2^k>L^C>=L^c, so no single fixed c makes full canonical 2-core enumeration polynomially admissible for every CNF.
trinity_firewall: The falsifier attacks only this carrier family. Trinity v4 solves cycle64 by DIRECT_NATIVE_2CNF_HORN_DUAL_HORN, so no Trinity incompleteness conclusion follows.
interpretation: The c=2 success on the frozen corpus cannot be promoted by choosing a larger global constant c. Wide cyclic incidence cores outrun every fixed polynomial branch budget if the algorithm insists on assigning every 2-core variable. Progress must come from quotienting, symbolic compression, or another exact carrier before enumeration.
